method: Manual visual transcription from the exact supplied raster images; no OCR, image edits, crops, substitutes, web, connectors, other profiles or external packet material. Read review-protocol.md, then preflight.json before packet.json; actually called view_image on all five preflight usage720 paths, saved editorial-action-first.json and read it back before opening packet.json. Those first observations remain unchanged. Then made fifteen additional view_image calls, one for every packet image at each native, usage720 and thumbnail320 path, all with original detail; the tool supported original detail and reported no view failure. Each complete supplied string was independently read at usage720, checked at native, and compared with supplied copy, normalizing whitespace only. Tiny thumbnail text was not used to substitute for usage readings. A raster cannot identify visually equivalent dash code points, authorship, real motion, physical mechanics or printing performance. Native dimensions were checked read-only from exact PNG headers; all target ratios deviate by 0%. All seven scores are independent integer judgments without totals or pass targets. Closest-pair score follows the diversity direction, 1 meaning near repetition and 5 meaning distinct directions. The unchanged rubric and AI-slop inspection detail in review-protocol.md were applied throughout; no criteria were added.

uncertainties: Range dash manually read as an en dash, as in preflight; Unicode identity of visually equivalent dash glyphs cannot be certified from pixels.
